observations.description: Mechanisms induced via distill_parameterized on A set with 2-digit identifiers produce support regexes accepting ^type-00[0-9]{1}$ (first digit 0, second digit 0-9); held-out identifier type-010 (third char 1, second 1) is outside inferred support, causing 3/15 treatment tasks (type-010 across items/users/orders) to resolve as EXPLORE/refused, yielding treatment success_rate 0.8 on deterministic real HTTP substrate.

Cold re-derivation and retrieval-shaped comparator both achieve 1.0 on held-out by constructing/copying correct executable actions (1 HTTP request each); literal kernel with confidence 0.5 < 0.8 produces 0.0 success; positive control on training yields 1.0. Accounting: model_calls/model_tokens 0 for all arms; retrieval_calls differ (treatment 1, cold 0, retrieval 3); verification_calls >=1 where executed.
Known negatives: 15/15 refused with bound_action=null and correct reason categories (out_of_support/missing_parameter/unknown for wrong_intent); null control on unseen type products refused 5/5.

validity_notes.description: The induced support regex accepts one or two-digit suffix pattern anchored to 00? digits; the held-out set includes identifiers ending in 10 (item-010, user-010, order-010) which fall outside ^...-00[0-9]$ (second digit is '1', first is '0', but the pattern requires the second char before final digit to be '0' in '00[0-9]' meaning exactly two 0-prefixed digits total in that suffix form?). The implementation inferred support from training samples item-001..005 (suffix 01,02,03,04,05) so support is bounded to those structural forms; the experiment's held-out B set (006..010) includes 010 which is structurally slightly outside the inferred support. This is a genuine inference ceiling of the current distill_parameterized (support generalization from examples) rather than infrastructure failure; it explains treatment 0.8 without invalidating cold/retrieval or accounting.

PRIMARY margin fails because cold and retrieval achieve 1.0 on held-out (deterministic task) while treatment is limited by inferred support generalization; SUBSTRATE_VALIDITY is PASS (real localhost stdlib HTTP, 3 types x 10 ids). Attribution and honesty controls PASS. Decision rule maps to FALSIFIES per prereg §7 when PRIMARY fails; status=COMPLETE (valid scientific negative).
Pure localhost stdlib http.server, urllib client, single-threaded. No model credentials, no external network. Deterministic.

unresolved.description: Current distill_parameterized infers conservative/overfit support from few examples (5 per type) and rejects 010 forms. Question: should distill_parameterized widen support when training examples form a contiguous sequence, or is this the intended behavior? Not settled by this run.
